channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Azerbaijan welcoming ‘set-jetting’ fans of Japan TV drama ‘Vivant’
item.description: Fans of popular Japanese TV drama "Vivant" have flocked to Azerbaijan, where the second season of the hit series was filmed.

item.title: Magnitude 5.7 quake injures dozens in central Japan
item.description: The quake struck at 1:04 am in Shizuoka Prefecture but no tsunami warning was issued.

item.title: Japan holds nuclear disaster drill simulating Tomari plant accident
item.description: With close to 8,500 local residents taking part, the drill includes exercises conducted at the Tomari plant for the first time in 10 years.

item.title: New Zealand preliminary vote leaves it unclear who will govern
item.description: Neither current Prime Minister Christopher Luxon nor opposition leader Chris Hipkins claimed victory in their speeches following the election.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
